d: Pale honey-blonde hair with a soft texture flows long past the shoulders, featuring long bangs that frame a youthful, mature face. The eyes are a pale silver with a calm, wide-eyed expression. The build is slender, dressed in a white and charcoal grey dress accented with red trim, paired with a white beret featuring a red pom-pom and a red, white, and blue striped ribbon tied at the chest. Signature details include white gloves and a large, grey mechanical ship rigging assembly positioned behind the back.
